articles.title: Palestinian parents fear for children's lives at school as settler attacks grow
articles.description: A headteacher in the occupied West Bank has installed new barbed wire fencing after three pupils were killed this year.

articles.title: Germany's far-right AfD says 'democracy demands' parties work with them after state election win
articles.description: The far-right party is trying to form a government in the state after falling three seats short of a majority.

articles.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanese village kill 12
articles.description: Lebanon says a recent Israeli escalation is jeopardising a US-brokered ceasefire meant to end the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah.

articles.title: Kyiv air raid alerts at record high as Russia launches round-the-clock strikes
articles.description: Schools, businesses and public transport are all struggling with the surge in Russian air attacks.

articles.title: EU to invest £171m in Greenland amid Trump tensions
articles.description: The EU is to invest €200m (£171m) in Greenland to improve relations with the Arctic island amid tensions caused by Donald Trump's demands that the territory be handed over to the US.

articles.title: Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon kill at least 12 people
articles.description: Israeli strikes on a southern Lebanese village killed at least 12 people, including women and children, Lebanon's health ministry said.

articles.title: FIFA confirms Infantino to stand for re-election as president
articles.description: FIFA has confirmed Gianni Infantino is standing for re-election next year after the president declined Sky News questions on his future in the job, now insisting "nothing has changed".
